title: Deterministic \(\widetilde O(n^{5/2})\) worst-case dynamic APSP

import_provenance.original_title: Derandomizing the n^{5/2} worst-case dynamic APSP bound
import_provenance.original_statement: Maintain exact distances in a directed weighted graph under insertion or deletion of a vertex and its incident edges, with constant-time distance queries and Õ(n²) space. Can deterministic worst-case update time match the Õ(n^{5/2}) randomized bound?
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: The Õ(n²) amortized update target and the randomized Õ(n^{5/2}) worst-case target are already achieved. This is the deterministic worst-case strengthening, for graphs with no negative cycles.
